# Support

## Getting help

- **Questions and discussion** — Open a thread in [Discussions](https://github.com/philsherry/govuk-design-system-skills/discussions).
- **Bug or incorrect guidance** — Open an [issue](https://github.com/philsherry/govuk-design-system-skills/issues/new/choose) using the "Incorrect guidance" template.
- **New content request** — Open an [issue](https://github.com/philsherry/govuk-design-system-skills/issues/new/choose) using the "New content request" template.

## GOV.UK Design System support

This project is not maintained by GDS. For questions about the GOV.UK Design System itself:

- [GOV.UK Design System community](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/community/)
- [GOV.UK Frontend GitHub repository](https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-frontend)
- [Cross-government Slack](https://ukgovernmentdigital.slack.com/) — #design-system channel
